question: Which of the following was a major drawback of the Indian economy at the time of independence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**High unemployment and poverty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• At the time of independence, **India's economy was severely underdeveloped**, marked by widespread **poverty and unemployment**.
 
• The colonial policies led to the destruction of traditional industries, such as **handicrafts and textiles**, leaving millions of workers jobless.
